<function name="GetByIndex" parent="ents" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns an entity by its index. Same as <page>Global.Entity</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="entIdx" type="number">The index of the entity.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Entity">The entity if it exists, or `NULL` if it doesn't.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
